description: This file 'convert.c' handles file conversion during checkout and check-in processes in a version control system (git). It includes functions for encoding, decoding, line ending normalization, binary detection, and support for external and streaming filters related to file content transformations.

classes.name: convert_driver
classes.description: Represents an external conversion driver with its name, associated commands for smudge, clean, processing, and whether it's required.

classes.name: filter_params
classes.description: Holds parameters for filtering operations, including source data, file descriptors, command, and path.

classes.name: stream_filter
classes.description: Abstract interface for stream filters with functions for filtering data and releasing resources.

classes.name: lf_to_crlf_filter
classes.description: Stream filter converting LF to CRLF line endings.

classes.name: cascade_filter
classes.description: Composite filter applying two filters in sequence.

classes.name: ident_filter
classes.description: Stream filter handling identification strings like $Id$ in files.
